description: Podgorica utility reports provide water-consumption observations for 2012-2019 and 2021, joined with temperature, precipitation and tourist arrivals for demand prediction. This resource is provided by Željka Beljkaš. Coverage is city as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The periods are discontinuous. This is a single-city study compilation. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
